config_coupling.effect: The explicit Domain-shape check selects a boundary, data-object, config-read or reference command by its declared tool ID. Concord declares only required_checks = [go-test-race], not those four commands; missing observations therefore remain unverified. Required-check membership and a successful command exit do not establish extractor coverage or workflow execution evidence.
config_coupling.source: The domain_shape section of .concord/tooling.v1.json. The operator check pins tooling from the Project's default revision and rejects candidate-only tooling or a widened candidate ratchet.
